value.rationale: The source isolates a five-TIGM phase only at \(k=2\). The new exact sequence \(\lambda_*(k)\) explains the special constant \(49/9\), gives the local branch orientation on both sides for every order, resolves the degenerate point with a strict quartic sign, and proves a nonempty five-measure coexistence interval for every \(k\ge2\). This is a natural structural phase-bifurcation extension of the source rather than a routine parameter substitution.
